expiring_ticket_synthetic_case_passed.formula: cases whose instantiated ticket, single-node scope, event-derived ticket/execution coupling, observation-batch parity, six paired accessibility fixtures, applicable SLA observations, substantiated public return, residual crosswalk and artifact records all pass; any failure forces audit exit 1
assumptions: E2 synthetic pass status does not prove site access, operating performance, a legal role, professional approval or implementation.

expiring_ticket_negative_path_fail_close.formula: declared in-memory mutations rejected / ten declared mutations: post-term unauthorized release, raw export, undersized aggregate output, unmapped derivative, missing stopping coupling, missing public-return deliverable, below-target public value, empty return evidence, unauthorized cross-node scope, and both routes failing the same accessibility task
assumptions: The passing result means the illegal synthetic action was blocked; it is not evidence that withdrawal fails.

expiring_ticket_no_data_rule_coverage_ra.formula: passed no-data equivalence checks / all applicable checks (22 / 22 across two cases): attempts, both time conditions, price, failures, core schema, safety alerts, 6 tasks x 2 routes of synthetic accessibility-fixture coverage, human takeover and complaint channels; no observed usability performance
assumptions: Thresholds are executable E2 design gates pending authorized E3 field measurement and E4 professional/operator confirmation.

expiring_ticket_conditional_artifact_cov.formula: valid artifact records / conditionally required records (24 / 24 across two cases); each record must satisfy minimum fields, identity, role, state, timestamp and resolvable content pointers
assumptions: Synthetic record coverage proves a machine-readable E2 evidence contract, not that field artifacts or responsible entities exist.
